name: Tangle Scarf
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level bard 2, legendary ninja 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a silk scarf )

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous; see text
Saving Throw none and Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like scarf of slashing steel, but if you hit the target it is entangled (Reflex negates) and rooted to the spot for 1 round/level. The target can escape the tangle scarf with a successful DC 20 Escape Artist check or DC 26 Strength check. The entangled creature cannot attack scarf, but an ally can try to destroy it and free the trapped creature; the tangle scarf is as strong as steel, with hardness 10 and hit points equal to 1d4 plus your caster level. You may choose to make a melee touch or ranged touch attack with a tangle scarf rather than a normal attack roll. A hit with the tangle scarf as a touch attack deals no damage but can still entangle the target as described above.
